key_metric: The FY27 guidance action - where the new adjusted operating income / adjusted EPS range lands within or above $480-560m and $9.20-11.00 - underwritten by the Q2 merchandise gross margin rate under gold at +21% YoY. Citi's public catalyst watch set the bar explicitly at 'inline Q2 plus raise to the top end of the prior range'.

notes.analyst_coverage_correction: Triage's selection_rationale stated '3 analysts'. That is materially understated: 11 analysts contribute estimates (stockanalysis.com), 12 ratings are outstanding (1 Strong Buy / 5 Buy / 6 Hold), and at least 10 distinct sell-side firms are demonstrably active - Stephens, Jefferies, Citi, BofA, Wells Fargo, Goldman Sachs, UBS, Telsey and Northcoast all asked questions on the Q1 FY27 call, plus Raymond James initiated separately. The triage thesis that thin coverage leaves room for bridal/promotional-cadence synthesis does not hold.
notes.historical_moves_up_down: 6 up / 2 down; last four: up, up, down, up
notes.excluded_datum: A widely-surfaced 'August 2026 US retail sales +0.6%' claim was deliberately excluded: the Census advance report for August 2026 is not due until mid-September 2026, after this print, and the figure appears to be a misattributed prior-year datapoint.
